content: Jjiřat n Adam ař Ibrahim d Isḥaq d Yaɛqub
Adam, Cit, Anuc,
Qinan, Mahalal-Il, Yarad,
Ḥanux, Matucalaḥ, Lamak,
Nuḥ, Cam, Ḥam, Yafat.
Arrawen n Yafat tuɣa aten d Jumar, Majuj, Maday, Yawan, Tubal, Macik d Tiras.
Arrawen n Jumar tuɣa aten d Ackanaz, Difat d Tujarma.
Arrawen n Yawan tuɣa aten d Ilica, Tarcica, Ikittiyyen d Idudaniyyen.
Arrawen n Ḥam tuɣa aten d Kuc, Miṣrayim, Fuṭ d Kenɛan.
Arrawen n Kuc tuɣa aten d Seba, Ḥawila, Sabta, Raɛama d Sabtaka. Arrawen n Raɛama tuɣa aten d Caba d Dadan.
Kuc ijja-dd Nimrud. Wanita ibda ad yiři d ijj n jjiheř x temmurt.
Miṣrayim ijja-dd Iludiyyen, Iɛanamiyyen, Ilahabiyyen, Inaftuḥiyyen,
Ifatrusiyyen, Ikasluḥiyyen, inni zi i dd-iqqarṣen Ifilisṭiniyyen, uřa d Ikafturiyyen.
Kenɛan ijja-dd Ṣidun, amenzu nnes, d Ḥit,
Ayabusi, Amuri, Ajirjaci,
Aḥiwi, Aɛarqi, Asiniy,
Arwadi, Aṣamari d Uḥamati.
Arrawen n Cam tuɣa aten d Ɛilam Accur, Arfakcad, Lud, Aram, Ɛuz, Ḥul, Jatar d Macik.
Arfakcad ijja-dd Calaḥ u Calaḥ ijja-dd Ɛabir.
Ttwarwen-dd i Ɛabir tnayen n warrawen. Ijjen qqaren as Falaj, minzi deg wussan nnes tᵉttwabḍa temmurt, uca qqaren as i umas Yuqṭan.
Yuqṭan ijja-dd Almudad, Calaf, Haḍarmawt, Yaraḥ,
Haduram, Uzal, Diqla,
Ɛibal, Abimayil, Caba,
Ufir, Ḥawila d Yubab. Marra ina tuɣa aten d arrawen n Yuqṭan.
Cam, Arfakcad, Calaḥ,
Ɛabir, Falaḥ, Raɛuw,
Saruj, Naḥur, Taraḥ,
Abram, wa d Ibrahim.
Arrawen n Ibrahim tuɣa aten d Isḥaq d Ismaɛil.
Ina d inni zzaysen dd-ittwarwen: amenzu n Ismaɛil tuɣa-t d Nabayut, xenni Qidar, Adabil, Mibsam,
Micmaɛ, Duma, Massa, Ḥadad d Tayma,
Yaṭur, Nafic d Qidma. Ina tuɣa aten d arrawen n Ismaɛil.
Arrawen n Qaṭura, tayya n Ibrahim: nettat turuw-dd Zimran, Yuqcan, Madan, Midyan, Yicbaq d Cuḥa. Arrawen n Yuqcan tuɣa aten d Caba d Dadan.
Arrawen n Midyan tuɣa aten d Ɛiyfa, Ɛifar, Ḥanux, Abidaɛ d Aldaɛa. Nitni marra tuɣa aten d arrawen n Qaṭura.
Ibrahim ijja-dd Isḥaq. Arrawen n Isḥaq tuɣa aten d Ɛisu d Israil.
Arrawen n Ɛisu tuɣa aten d Ilifaz, Raɛuwil, Yaɛuc, Yaɛlam d Quraḥ.
Arrawen n Ilifaz tuɣa aten d Tayman, Umar, Ṣafi, Jaɛtam, Qinaz, Timnaɛ d Ɛamaliq.
Arrawen n Raɛuyil tuɣa aten d Naḥat, Zaraḥ, Camma d Mizza.
Arrawen n Saɛir tuɣa aten d Luṭan, Cubal, Ṣibɛun, Ɛana, Dicun, Iṣar d Dican.
Arrawen n Luṭan tuɣa aten d Axuri d Humam uca tuɣa Timnaɛ d učmas n Luṭan.
Arrawen n Cubal tuɣa aten d Ɛalyan, Manaḥat, Ɛibal, Cafi d Unam. Arrawen n Ṣibɛun tuɣa aten d Aya d Ɛana.
Arrawen n Ɛana mɣir: Dicun. Arrawen n Dicun tuɣa aten d Ḥamran, Icban, Yitran d Karan.
Arrawen n Iṣar tuɣa aten d Bilhan d Zaɛwan d Yaɛkan. Arrawen n Dicun tuɣa aten d Ɛuṣ d Aran.
Ina d ijeǧiden i tuɣa iǧan x Idum, qbeř ma tuɣa iḥekkem ijj n ujeǧid x ayt n Israil: Bilaɛ, mmis n Baɛur. Tandint nnes qqaren as Dinhaba.
Immut Bilaɛ uca Yuwab, mmis n Zaraḥ, zi Buṣra, idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Immut Yuwab uca Ḥucam zi temmurt n Itaymaniyyen idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Immut Ḥucam uca Hadad mmis n Badad wenni iɣeřben Midyan deg iyyar n Mu’ab, idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes. Isem n tendint nnes qqaren as Ɛawit.
Immut Hadad uca Samla zi Masriqa idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Immut Samla uca Cawul, zi Raḥubut ɣar yeɣzar n Lfuraṭ, idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Immut Cawul uca Baɛl-Ḥanan, mmis n Ɛakbur, idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Immut Baɛl-Ḥanan uca Hadad idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes. Tandint nnes qqaren as Faɛi u tamɣart nnes qqaren as Mahiṭab’il, yeǧis n Maṭrid, yeǧis n Ma-Dahab.
Immut Hadad uca xenni dewřen yina d imɣaren n Idum: amɣar Timnaɛ, d umɣar Ɛalwa, d umɣar Yatit,
d umɣar Ahulibama, d umɣar Ila, d umɣar Finun,
d umɣar Qanaz, d umɣar Tayman, d umɣar Mibṣar,
d umɣar Majdiyil, d umɣar Ɛiram. Ina tuɣa aten d imɣaren n tqebbař n Idum.

footnotes.text: Qinaz- deg wedlis Amz. 36:11 nufa ‘Zifu’. Timnaɛ- isem wanita war t nufa deg wedlis Amezwaru, udem 36. Ad taɣ iceyyar isem wanita ɣar ict n temɣart tenni taru Ɛamaliq i Ilifaz.
Ɛalyan- deg wedlis Amz. 36:23 nufa ‘Ɛalwan’. Cafi- deg wedlis Amz. 36:23 nufa ‘Cafu’. Ṣibɛun- deg wedlis Amz. 36:24 nufa ‘Ṣabɛun’.
Hadad- deg wedlis Amz. 36:39 nufa ‘Hadar’. Pahi- deg wedlis Amz. 36:39 nufa ‘Pahu’.
